about: See who qualifies for the 10-year Golden Residence and what it allows.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Golden Residence guide. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: 10-year residence that renews automatically, with no sponsor needed
Investors in public investments: 2,000,000 AED deposit, company capital or partnership share, or a business paying at least 250,000 AED a year in federal taxes
Real estate investors: property worth at least 2,000,000 AED, which may be bank-financed, or off-plan units from an approved developer
Entrepreneurs: an SME with at least 1,000,000 AED yearly revenue, an approved idea, or earlier ventures sold for at least 7,000,000 AED
Skilled professionals: valid work permit, a bachelor's degree and a salary of at least 30,000 AED a month in the top two occupation levels
Outstanding students, exceptional talents and humanitarian pioneers also qualify under set criteria
Health insurance is needed in the investor, entrepreneur and specialist categories
documents: Document lists differ by category; the guide page does not list them
fees: The guide page states no fees; see the Golden Residence visa services for amounts
timing: The guide page gives no timing
channels: ICP eligibility checker on the website
